'''''Koh-Lanta: Vanuatu''''' is the sixth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from July 21 to September 5, 2006, with each episode airing at 8:55 p.m.

[[François-David Cardonnel]] defeated [[Émilie Frahi]] in a 5-3 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]]. To date, this season has produced three returning players (Émilie Frahi, François-David Cardonnel and [[Ludovic Laresche]]) for future seasons.

== Production ==
This season was filmed in Efate, Vanuatu. Along with the typical aspects of the game, this season, castaways had to deal with both a cyclone and a series of earthquakes (one of which damaged the [[Immunity Idol]]).

==Twists/Changes==
* '''[[Older vs. Younger|Old vs. Young]]:''' Similar to the [[Koh-Lanta: Pacifique|previous season]], the castaways were divided on the basis of age. The {{tribeicon|mosso}} tribe consisted of castaways over the age of 30, and the {{tribeicon|tana}} tribe consisted of castaways aged 30 and younger.
* '''Replacements:''' Due to three [[evacuation]]s, three castaways ([[Nathalie Penigaud]], [[Sébastien Roullé]] and [[Alain Ponton]]) returned to the game after being voted out.
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:''' After winning the [[Reward Challenge]] on Day 13, Tana could permanently take one of [[Mosso]]'s members. They chose Sébastien.
